gloss: to get dark; to come to an end (day, year)

definitions.gloss: to get dark; (of the sun) to set
definitions.explanation: Said of the day or the sun: evening comes and it grows dark. The subject is almost always {日|ひ} (the day or the sun).

definitions.gloss: to come to an end (a year, a season)
definitions.explanation: Said of a year or season drawing to its close, as in {年|とし}が{暮|く}れる. Also the source of {暮|く}れ, the end of the year.

examples.english: In winter it gets dark early.
We'd better get down the mountain before it gets dark.
The year draws to a close.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧あと⟦{数日|すうじつ}→数日：20517_suujitsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{暮|く}れる。
examples.english: This year too will be over in a few days.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しく→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧うち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦あっという{間|ま}に→あっという間に：25467_attoiumani⟧⟦{一年|いちねん}→一年：10994_ichinen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{暮|く}れてしまった。
examples.english: I kept busy every day, and the year was over before I knew it.

notes:
An intransitive verb whose subject is a stretch of time: the day, the year, a season. The opposite is ⟦{明|あ}ける→明ける：21288_akeru⟧ (dawn breaks; a new year or the rainy season begins).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{暮|く}れる: it gets dark
- ⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{暮|く}れる: the year ends
- ⟦{途方|とほう}→途方：09447_tohou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{暮|く}れる: to be at a loss, not know what to do
- ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{暮|く}れる: to be overcome with grief, spend one's days in tears
- ⟦{明|あ}けて→明ける：21288_akeru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{暮|く}れて⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: day in, day out

WATCH OUT:
⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧ written in kana is the everyday giving verb (to give me, to do for me). {暮|く}れる always has a time word as its subject or sits in one of the set phrases above.
